title: AWR Capacity - Tablespaces
description: Tablespace usage from AWR: observed daily, forecast to a year out, days to full, and the growth days the anomaly layer flagged.

panels.title: Tablespaces CRIT
panels.description: Latest fit says full in 30 days or less (or already past the near-full line).

panels.title: Growth anomalies in range
panels.description: Days whose growth rate was far outside the tablespace's own median rate (robust z-score), one per day and baseline mode (trailing, same weekday).

panels.title: Days to full (latest fit per tablespace, soonest first)
panels.description: Days to full is the linear fit projected at today's slope; low/high come from the forecast band. CRIT at 30 days or less, WARN at 90. Restart: why the fit window is shorter than the training window (PURGE, growth that stopped = STOP or began = START) and its first day. Track: the grade of the series' earlier forecasts (GOOD, BIASED, WIDE; UNKNOWN until enough are old enough to check).

panels.title: Used space: observed, forecast (dashed), anomalies (red)
panels.description: Left of today: observed daily used bytes. Right of today: the REGR forecast (dashed) with its low/high band (dotted). Grey dashed: the ceiling (MAXBYTES or operator override). Red dots and red markers: growth anomalies; hover a marker for the explanation.

panels.title: Daily growth (sum of selected tablespaces; red = flagged day)
panels.description: Per-day growth summed over the selected tablespaces. A red bar is the growth of the tablespaces flagged that day; the grey line is the sum of their median daily growth, which the anomaly test measures against.

panels.title: Shared disk: when is the disk under the datafiles full?
panels.description: All datafiles of a database are taken to sit on one disk. Free space: the operator's CAP_DISK_OVERRIDE row, else derived from the live tablespace ceilings (LIVE), else not known (NONE). Days to full: until the growing tablespaces have taken it. DISK_FULL alerts at 90 and 30 days.

panels.title: Tablespaces on the shared disk: days alone, days once the disk is full
panels.description: Growing tablespaces only. Days, alone: to the tablespace's own limit (its ceiling, or the live ceiling when that is lower). Days, shared disk: until it is stuck, at its own limit or the first time it must extend after the disk is full. Stopped by says which.

panels.title: Tablespace families: the next member's size, the filling member against its ceiling
panels.description: Tablespaces of one container whose names differ only in a period (month, quarter, year) are a family. Next member: the size the next one needs, from the finished members. Fits = N: the member that fills now may pass its ceiling before its period ends (the TBSPC_FAMILY alert).

panels.title: Family members in period order
panels.description: In the handler's order: database, family, period. DONE: filled, or growth stopped. FILLING: the newest member that grows. EMPTY: created ahead. Final size: the largest used size of a DONE member.
